label: run153 waha haircut perplant
definition: run152 with the Waha contract haircut made PER-PLANT instead of zone-average: each gas unit's hub basis is scaled by ITS OWN EIA-923 spot share, so 100%-spot units (Permian Basin, Laredo) keep the full discount while a 100%-contract unit in the same zone (Ector County, share 0.0) loses it entirely. More physically faithful than the zone mean AND a better fit every year (CLAUDE.md #11/#12): CT_PEAKER 2023 -17.6% (was -25.9%), 2024 +48.7% (was +68.6%), 2025 +62.7% (was +66.8%). 358/1124 gas units haircut (mean share 0.51). LMP MAE 27.8/15.2/11.3 (no regression); C2 gas/coal family, C4 dispatch, C5a CO2 pass. The remaining CT_PEAKER over-run (2024 +4.0 TWh) is the open direction-3 MODEL MISS (the 100%-spot Permian peakers genuinely see cheap Waha gas, so the fix is peaker economics/classification, not gas price). The -0.50 floor is NOT used (dropped as non-physical). See docs/ercot-ct-waha-offer-floor-2026-06.md.
